title: Zion's Call
firstLine: Zion's call sweetly rings over land and sea,

lines: Zion's call sweetly rings over land and sea,
Bidding us look to realms above;
While the light from the throne shines for you and me,
Let us list to the call of love.
On the road to the goal burdens we must bear,
But we have help from realms above;
We receive courage new when we kneel in pray'r,
Let us list to the call of love.
While we tarry below there is work to do
And our strength cometh from above,
As we labor and wait we must all be true,
Let us list to the call of love.
Let us heed the call of love.
